question: Can I try it before paying?
answer: Yes. The Free plan is free for one site with every section, for as long as you like. Pro and Team start with a 14-day trial, no card needed.

question: Do my editors need to know Blade?
answer: No. They click a headline or an image on the page and change it there. Developers keep working in the same files with their own editor.

question: Where does my content live?
answer: In your repository. Pages are Blade files, lists are JSON collections, and every change shows up as an ordinary diff you can review.

question: Can I change plans later?
answer: Upgrades apply the same day and we prorate the difference on your next invoice. Downgrades take effect at the end of the billing period, so you never lose time you already paid for.

question: What happens if we stop using Starter?
answer: Your site keeps serving. The runtime is one service provider in your app with no dependency on the editor, so you can remove the editor at any time.

question: What kind of support do you offer?
answer: Email on every plan with replies within one business day, chat on Pro from 8 AM to 6 PM ET, and same-day help on Team.
